title: FIG. 4. CARLISLE, COURSE OF THE WALL AND OF THE YALLUM.
name: Carlisle, plan of the course of the Wall and of the Vallum between Stanwix and the Castle, with the 1857-58 great sewer, Maclauchlan (1858)
desc: Maclauchlan, Memoir, Written During a Survey of the Roman Wall (1858), Fig. 4: the binder's directions (djvu leaf 119) say 'The Plans, Fig. 4, 6, Carlisle and the Camp on Skew Hill at page 76.'; the running head on p.77 is 'CARLISLE, COURSE OF THE WALL AND OF THE YALLUM.' (See Plans, Fig. 4.). Plan of Carlisle: the course of the Wall and the Vallum between Stanwix and the Castle, with the 1857-58 great sewer and its drain; 'H M^L delin', Sandridge & Co. Litho London. The only site plan still legible in this copy (n0078 and n0111 are blank here - docs/lead_roman.md). Internet Archive memoirwrittendu00maclgoog, leaf n0093 of the 171-leaf 1858 original.
